explanation: The hypothesis captures only the generic idea of a thermally induced ductile–brittle–ductile sequence and offers a testable thermal-cycling experiment. It otherwise reconstructs the conventional-alloy baseline rather than the reported HEA result. The target material is as-cast AlCoCrFeNi2.1 eutectic HEA with FCC and B2 phases. Its minimum ductility after aging near 600 °C arises from strong L12 ordering and jagged B2/FCC boundaries that promote planar slip, dislocation pile-ups, stress concentration, and plastic instability; ductility returns near 750 °C as ordering decreases and ductile transition zones form along phase boundaries. The generated account provides neither this material nor its governing structure and conditions.
